title: Show HN: PicoMQ – Durable Streams over HTTP, on object storage
summary: PicoMQ is a Rust-based server that provides durable streams over HTTP, built on top of object storage (S3) for cost-effective message queuing. It offers URL-addressable granular streams with operations like create/append/read/long-poll and SSE support, using S3Stream as the underlying storage primitive from AutoMQ.
problem_solved: Provides a cheap, scalable alternative to traditional message brokers by leveraging object storage for durable stream persistence.
why_valuable: Enables developers to build event-driven architectures with durable streams at object storage costs, eliminating the need for expensive dedicated message queue infrastructure.
